Made misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and /or Record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history and financial failures etc. and /or Participated in the previous tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high tender prices and could not furnish rational justification.
